text.tspan: L0: qualified toolchain / runtime bundle
Source + patches + VM/SMP/GC profile
Target ABI / SDK / tools / protocol generation
L1: immutable generation product
Generated C OR resolved semantic export + FFI record
Source / macro / import closure and effective assumptions
L2: module native product
Object + required metadata / provenance
Headers / tool options / runtime ABI / service-pass identity
L3: composition and native link product
Ordered members / aliases / initializers
Linker / libraries / deployment configuration
L4: published AOT closure
Matched modules + dependencies + manifests
Fetch / verify / admit / load remains consumer work
Bazel owns outer action cache
Current project action is a coarse tree artifact
Logical layers are not already separate Bazel actions
Optional inner reuse
Must survive sandbox and complete dependency checks
Preprocessed-byte key still pays preprocessing
Lookup / proof / copying / locks can exceed avoided work
INVALIDATION
Source / macro changes: affected generation and dependents
Runtime protocol changes: all dependent native artifacts
MLIR service changes: its outputs, not unrelated C outputs
Link-only changes: affected link products, subject to option semantics
DESIGN ONLY: cold build, warm hit, delta build and AOT delivery are distinct.
Historical Bazel/native receipts constrain the design; no new timing run.
